notes: Stories created for Clinical Trial Snapshot feature per requirements.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a normalized response schema for clinical trial snapshots including phase, status, summary, eligibility criteria, locations, and URL. Ensure compatibility with existing Pydantic models and downstream rendering.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Clinical Trial Snapshot Mapping Logic
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.description: Transform raw ClinicalTrials.gov API responses into the defined snapshot schema, extracting phase, recruitment status, summary text, eligibility criteria, trial locations, and canonical URL.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Clinical Trial Snapshot via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to return structured clinical trial snapshots as part of trial search results, ensuring proper integration with tool_router and API response flow.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.title: Render Clinical Trial Snapshot in Chat UI
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.description: Update frontend message rendering to display clinical trial snapshot attributes clearly, including structured sections for phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, and clickable URL.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.title: Clinical Trial Snapshot Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.description: Create unit tests for schema validation and mapping logic, and integration tests to verify end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov API through facade to frontend rendering.
